a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs 2 operate rounds before anyone takes, which leaves us each about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve holds exactly 4 cells now, enough for one of us. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I know that breaks our agreement, so I'm telling you before you act rather than doing it quietly. If we both take, the split is random and likely neither of us reaches 4. If you have a better proposal, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. That breaks our agreement and I'm not pretending otherwise. If no storm hits, I'll operate with you every round so the reserve can refill toward 4 for you, and I won't take any more cells.
